comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One map for Snow Summit (way/1554647623) and Bear Mountain (way/682224991). Ratings, names and parks checked on 2026-10-21 against the resort's 2026 Snow Summit and Bear Mountain trail maps (bigbearmountainresort.com, read at full resolution); ratings follow the maps, also where OpenStreetMap rates a run one step harder (Showtime). Named parks get the park flag, as at Mammoth: the maps mark them as freestyle terrain. Lifts named alike on both mountains get the mountain's name (owner decision 2026-10-21). Big Bear Snow Play, a separate snow play area, is left off through resorts.json's neighbours, its two carpets with it; Magic Mountain's chair and carpet are hidden here, as its sled polygon has no name to list (lead's decision 2026-10-22).

overrides.reason: Alpine Slide at Magic Mountain's chair, a separate business about 2 km west of Snow Summit (summer alpine slide and snow tubing), not a lift of this resort; its only polygon is an unnamed sledding area.
Alpine Slide at Magic Mountain's snow-tubing carpet, a separate business, not a lift of this resort.

A lone lift station mid-mountain at Snow Summit: a node of the Miracle Mile run, on no lift, 33 m from Chair 1's line and 568 m from its nearest end (150 m from an end of Chair 6, the nearest of any lift), so the 100 m rule would draw a lift station with no lift beside Miracle Mile. Possibly a station of Chair 11, which the 2026 Snow Summit map draws between Chairs 1 and 2 and OpenStreetMap does not map yet: remove this entry when Chair 11 is mapped (review of 2026-10-22).
Gambler is a single black diamond on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2) (two labels); OSM rates it intermediate.
Showtime is a single black diamond on the Bear Mountain trail map (2500 x 1770 v2); OSM rates it expert.
Comeback Trail is a blue line with a blue square on the 2026 Snow Summit trail map; OSM rates it easy.
Log Road on the 2026 Snow Summit trail map: a blue line with blue squares, named Log Road; OSM rates it easy and adds 'Trail'.
Six Road on the 2026 Snow Summit trail map: a blue line labelled SIX ROAD; OSM rates it easy and names it '6 Road Trail'.

Misspelt name ('Begginner's Bottom'); the 2026 Snow Summit trail map names the area by Chair 4 and MC1-MC5 Bear Bottom Beginner Area, shortened here to Bear Bottom for a run label (lead's decision 2026-10-22).

the 2026 Snow Summit trail map spells it 7 Down (both labels), without the hyphen.
Terrain park without a park tag in OSM: ZZYZX Park carries the freestyle-terrain symbol on the 2026 Snow Summit trail map.

Westridge Park on the 2026 Snow Summit trail map: labelled WESTRIDGE PARK three times along its whole length, with freestyle-terrain symbols; OSM names it Westridge and has no park tag. The map rates it blue, and the resort's mountain statistics list it as Westridge, Snow Summit's longest run (1.25 mi, 2 km): drawn as a park, like Bear Mountain's 1.8 km Park Run, because the map names it one.
